environment.topology: single-host laboratory (docker compose); primary and recovery databases are containers on one machine
environment.disclaimer: Demonstrates the recovery procedure. NOT geographic disaster recovery and NOT evidence of production recovery times.

objectives.note: Recovery to a chosen moment: every transaction committed before the target is expected, none after it.

summary: Failed: timed out after 600000 ms waiting for the recovery instance to reach the target and promote

steps.name: Prepare an empty work volume for the base backup
Take a physical base backup of the primary (pg_basebackup, replication role)
Write T1, choose the recovery target, write T2
Archive the WAL that contains both transactions
Start an isolated recovery instance: base backup + archived WAL, target time
steps.detail: timed out after 600000 ms waiting for the recovery instance to reach the target and promote

limitations: Both the primary and the recovery instance run on one workstation; this demonstrates the procedure only.
The WAL archive is a Docker volume on the same machine, kept for 3 days (WAL_ARCHIVE_RETENTION_DAYS). Production needs off-site archive storage.
Only the database cluster is recovered; services were not pointed at the recovered instance in this drill.
